All checks are consistent (19 fav + 29 unfav = 57 rows; 18 + 28 + 1 = 47 genes; HNRNPK is the one gene with both directions). Here is the complete answer.

## 1. Number of TP53 interaction partners

In the HPA consensus interaction network (`interaction_consensus`), **TP53 (ENSG00000141510) has 123 distinct interaction partners** (246 rows total — an exactly symmetric 123+123 split, no self-loop). Supporting datasets are IntAct/BioGRID plus OpenCell (e.g. `intact_biogrid`, `biogrid_opencell`, `intact_biogrid_opencell`).

## 2. Distribution of the partners' main subcellular location

Of the 123 partners, 114 have a defined "Subcellular main location" in the proteinatlas table (9 are empty*); 86 have a nuclear main location.

## 1. Number of TP53 interaction partners

In the HPA consensus interaction network (`interaction_consensus`), **TP53 (ENSG00000141510) has 123 distinct interaction partners** (246 rows total — an exactly symmetric 123+123 split, no self-loop).
